fusions.name: Shell-First Gallop
fusions.desc: Gallops to an enemy up to 7 tiles away and strikes shell-first, which deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Trampling Thunder
fusions.desc: Rears and brings your whole armoured weight down, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of its maximum health to a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Barded Charger
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 30% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Momentum Under the Shell
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 4% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.
